thread:
emily-cs: OptiFin reported a reproducible session resume bug. When they re-open a streaming session with the resume_token, responses either duplicate recent chunks or the chat state appears to reset mid-stream. They sent repro steps and logs below.

emily-cs: Repro steps (customer provided):
```
1) Create session: POST /v1/sessions { "model":"redwood/gptx-3-quant", "stream": true }
2) Send message A -> receive chunked stream
3) Close client, save resume_token from the stream metadata
4) Reconnect with resume_token and send message B -> response restarts from beginning of convo or duplicates last chunk

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"session_id":"optifin-sess","resume_token":"<token>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Follow up"}],"stream":true}'
```

jordan-support: Thanks, repro looks clear. Are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

emily-cs: Dedicated (us-west-2, reserved pool). Customer timestamp: Fri 2025-03-11. Model: redwood/gptx-3-quant v1.2.3, runtime: inference-runtime-2.4.0.

arjun-pm: Customer impact? Prod traffic? Revenue hit?

emily-cs: Prod. They observed ~20% of resumed streams with duplication or partial resets. Billing spike ~ $4k due to retries. Customer asking for ETA.

sasha-se: @liam-eng can you take a quick look? We need a minimal repro and the runtime's resume_token handling checked. Also get KV cache state if possible.

liam-eng: I'll take it. Can you drop the raw stream IDs, request_id, and SDK (node/python) sample? I want to reproduce locally against the dedicated fleet image.

jordan-support: Pasting node SDK snippet and raw logs from the customer below.
```
// node snippet (customer)
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.KEY })
const stream = client.chat.stream({ session_id: 'optifin-sess', stream: true })
// on 'meta' they send resume_token: "rt:abc123.v1"
// client closes connection unexpectedly, then reconnects with same resume_token

// raw log (trimmed)
[2025-03-11T14:12:03Z] stream_meta session=optifin-sess resume_token=rt:abc123.v1
[2025-03-11T14:12:07Z] stream_chunk session=optifin-sess chunk_id=41 content="...split token part A"
[2025-03-11T14:12:07Z] client_disconnect session=optifin-sess
[2025-03-11T14:12:22Z] reconnect_resume session=optifin-sess resume_token=rt:abc123.v1
[2025-03-11T14:12:22Z] stream_chunk session=optifin-sess chunk_id=0 content="...repeat part A"
```

triage-bot: :warning: Labelled as P1, created internal ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-4182, assigned to liam-eng.

liam-eng: I reproduced locally with the curl snippet against a dedicated replica. Initial suspicion: resume_token contains a version tag (v1) but runtime parsing in inference-runtime-2.4.0 expects v2 token frames after a recent change to prefix encoding. If a v1 token is passed to the newer parser it can reset position or misapply KV offsets -> duplicate chunks.

liam-eng: Immediate mitigation: tell customer to set "stream": false (non-streaming) or do a full session reset before resume (drop resume_token). I can prepare a patch to add a compatibility shim in the resume parser and a runtime check to reject mismatched token versions with a clear error.

arjun-pm: Good. Proposed plan: 1) hotfix compatibility shim + clear error message (P1) 2) backport patch to dedicated stable branch 3) notify customer with mitigation steps and ETA. ETA for hotfix?

liam-eng: ETA 48 hours for hotfix + rollout to dedicated pool (testing + canary). If we hit blockers will escalate. I'll include a fallback that rejects resume with an explicit 4xx and guidance to reset session.

emily-cs: I'll email OptiFin now with mitigation (disable resume or full reset) and offer to coordinate a scheduled maintenance for the hotfix.\n
arjun-pm: Please include a short postmortem template and timeline. Also capture telemetry we need to verify fix (resume_token version header, chunk_id continuity, request_id).

emily-cs: Will do. Thanks everyone. :eyes:

liam-eng: Assigning self to RI-4182, starting local PR. I'll post updates in this thread and link the PR. :thumbsup:
